findings.title: mean_chunk_score raises ZeroDivisionError on empty input despite documented 0.0 contract
findings.explanation: The new function's docstring on line 5 states "an empty list should produce 0.0", but the implementation on line 6 computes `sum(scores) / len(scores)`. For an empty list, `len(scores)` is 0, so the division raises `ZeroDivisionError` instead of returning 0.0. The documented contract and the actual behavior disagree, so any caller relying on the stated empty-input behavior will crash. The file is newly added in this PR (base has no such file), so this is a newly introduced defect. No callers or guards exist elsewhere in the repository (grep for `mean_chunk_score` returned no matches), so the function is the sole source of the behavior.
findings.trigger: Call `mean_chunk_score([])` (or pass any empty sequence of scores).
